page.layout: One page of title matter, centred in the upper half: a two-line heading in spaced capitals and roman, then a six-line italic epigram with a large initial S. Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.

l.i: Tantùm nudus homo manserat inde super.
Verùm nunc IVNIVS scribendo restituit rem:
Sic vt religio dixerit ipsa palam,
CHRISTVS qui fuerat nobis in mense Decembri
Natus, nunc iterum nascitur in Iunio.

page.notes: The large initial S of the epigram is joined to "ustulerat" as "Sustulerat". The faint mirrored lines above the heading (a PRAEFATIO / CATHOLICAE DOCTRINAE title and an imprint at the foot) and the faint line "Opus FRANCISCI IVNII" are show-through from the other side and are not transcribed. The top "III" is likewise not transcribed, being mirrored show-through. No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed on this page.
